bio: Cuban-Spanish actress who began her career in Cuba before working in Spain and later Hollywood. She is known for Blade Runner 2049, Knives Out, No Time to Die, Blonde and Ballerina.

Indian actress and former model who works primarily in Hindi, Kannada and Telugu cinema. She made her acting debut with Boni (2009) and is known for films including Googly, Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana and Housefull 4.
Canadian actor and musician known for The Matrix, John Wick, Speed, and Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure.
Indian actor known for acclaimed performances in Shahid, Newton, Queen, Stree, and other Hindi films.
